question: Should `text/vcard` become a default host-read document MIME when dependency-sniffed text documents must pass full-buffer validation?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but expanding which host-local files OpenClaw reads and sends by default is an intentional security-policy decision automation should not make.

options.title: Accept Validated vCards
options.body: Approve this canonical implementation and land after final owner review of the generated merge result.

options.title: Keep The Existing Boundary
options.body: Retain the current allowlist and require the existing explicit buffer workaround for vCards.
